table.name: TLGNR_TRUCK_TRANSPORT_CAT_BS
table.description: Transport categories for Trucks. Transport categories of truck/trailer/wagon/container generally define what kind of 'packaging' can be transported.

column.name: TRUCK_TRANSPORT_CAT_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 1=Silo (for bulk), 2=Container, 3=Auflieger/Trailer (-> category of trailer decides the actual transport category of the composition!), 4=Stueckgut/Mixed Goods (i.e. for pallets).

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
